title: premarket_prices record
description: One symbol's pre-market PRICES for the 09:30 forecast (premarket_live/prices-D.jsonl, written by `premarket prices`, read by `etrade export-next --prices`). One line per symbol; a later run of the same day replaces the file. export-next sets pm_last_pct_prev_vwap = last / previous session VWAP - 1 and open_pct_prev_vwap = open / previous session VWAP - 1 (both clipped +-0.30) and pm_px_known = 1 only when BOTH last and open are numbers (an open without a last leaves the group at 0). Prices are as the source quotes them today (split-adjusted by the current listing); a split executing on `date` masks the group. Live definitions differ from training (Massive): the last is the watchlist mid or ChartIQ's last bucket close, not the last trade.

last.description: Last pre-market price before 09:30 ET; null when unknown.

last_at.description: UTC ISO time of that price (the quote or bucket time); null when last is null.

open.description: The regular-session opening price of `date`; null before the stock opens (the --open pass fills it).

open_at.description: UTC ISO time of the open print; null when open is null.

source.description: Where last came from: watchlist, etrade_chartiq, massive, ...; a record may mix (the open can come from another source).

as_of.description: UTC ISO time the record was written.
